overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（5 篇）、房地产金融（3 篇）、银行与信贷（1 篇）。方法上以回归分析、机器学习为主。来源分布：arXiv（7 篇）、OpenAlex（3 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。

papers.title: Gaussian Noise–Augmented Machine Learning Models for Predicting the Healing Performance of Self-Healing Concrete
papers.venue: Journal of Materials in Civil Engineering
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Self-healing concrete is an innovative approach to extend concrete’s service life by autonomously repairing cracks, thereby reducing the environmental impact of the construction industry. Although a few studies have employed machine learning (ML) models to predict the healing efficiency of concrete, they often overlooked the impact of critical variables such as bacteria type, encapsulation method, and environmental conditions. In addition, their predictive performance was limited by data scarcity and weak generalization, resulting in lower
                    
                      
                        
                          
                            R
                          
                          
                            2
                          
                        
                      
                    
                    and higher root-mean square error (RMSE), and mean absolute error (MAE) values. This study applied train-fold-only Gaussian noise data augmentation to improve the generalization of ML models in predicting the self-healing efficiency of bacterial concrete. Data augmentation was embedded in a nested cross-validation scheme, using an outer fivefold StratifiedKFold and an inner threefold grid search cross-validation on the augmented training folds for hyperparameter tuning. Five ML algorithms, extreme gradient boosting (XGB), gradient boosting regression (GBR), support vector regression (SVR), long short-term memory (LSTM), and gated recurrent units (GRUs), were evaluated. Input variables included bacterial encapsulation techniques, healing conditions, and mix design parameters. The results showed that augmentation significantly enhanced model robustness and accuracy. XGB and GBR models achieved the highest
                    
                      
                        
                          
                            R
                          
                          
                            2
                          
                        
                      
                    
                    values of 0.92 and 0.91, respectively, with substantial reductions in RMSE and MAE values compared with nonaugmented models. These results indicate a notable improvement in prediction reliability over prior studies. Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) and permutation analyses confirmed healing time and initial crack width as dominant features in both models. XGB captured more nonlinear variation in secondary features, whereas GBR exhibited more consistent and balanced attributions. These findings provide deeper insights into model behavior beyond conventional accuracy metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要

自修复混凝土是一种创新技术，通过自主修复混凝土中的裂缝来延长其使用寿命，从而降低建筑行业对环境的影响。尽管已有部分研究采用机器学习（ML）模型来预测混凝土的自修复效率，但这些研究往往忽略了细菌类型、封装方法以及环境条件等关键因素的影响。此外，由于数据稀缺和泛化能力较弱，这些模型的预测性能受到限制，导致均方根误差（RMSE）和平均绝对误差（MAE）值较高。

本研究仅使用训练数据集进行了高斯噪声数据增强处理，以提高机器学习模型在预测细菌诱导混凝土自修复效率方面的泛化能力。数据增强方法被纳入嵌套交叉验证方案中：外部采用五折分层交叉验证（StratifiedKFold），内部通过三折网格搜索交叉验证对增强后的训练数据进行超参数调整。评估了五种机器学习算法：极端梯度提升（XGB）、梯度提升回归（GBR）、支持向量回归（SVR）、长短期记忆网络（LSTM）和门控循环单元（GRUs）。输入变量包括细菌封装技术、修复条件以及混合设计参数。结果表明，数据增强显著提升了模型的鲁棒性和预测准确性。XGB和GBR模型的预测准确率分别达到了0.92和0.91，且其RMSE和MAE值相较于未增强模...。研究方法：回归分析、机器学习、梯度提升。

papers.title: The Complex Value of Temporary Communities
papers.abstract: Across Europe, a shortage of affordable housing and workspace coexists with widespread vacancy in buildings, lots, and public spaces. Since the 1970s, squatting, anti-squatting, and co-management practices have turned this contradiction into an opportunity, with young people, activists, and creatives temporarily reclaiming empty spaces and, when displaced by rising rents, forming urban nomad communities. While the social and cultural relevance of these initiatives is widely recognised, the value they generate—and how to assess it—remains poorly understood. This thematic issue brings together 10 contributions that examine how temporary reuse of real estate and public space creates value for real estate management, urban development, and local communities, and why diverse actors choose to engage in it. The collected articles present cases from Belgium, the Netherlands, Portugal, Germany, Italy, Curaçao, and Australia, and identify four interrelated dimensions of value: activation, commons, care, and transformation that unfold differently across places, scales, and temporalities. Together, they argue that temporary communities generate effects that persist beyond the end of the temporary use itself, reshaping perceptions of place and future development trajectories, and call for new frameworks to recognise and support this complex value.
papers.summary_zh: 【房地产金融】在欧洲各地，经济适用住房和工作空间的短缺与建筑物、土地及公共空间的普遍空置现象并存。自20世纪70年代以来，擅自占用空置房屋的行为、反擅自占用政策以及共同管理实践将这一矛盾转化为一种机遇：年轻人、社会活动家及创意人士暂时占据这些空置空间；当租金上涨迫使他们迁离时，又会形成城市游牧社区。尽管这些举措的社会和文化意义已得到广泛认可，但其所产生的价值以及如何评估这种价值仍缺乏深入理解。本期专题汇集了10篇研究文章，探讨了房地产和公共空间的临时再利用如何为房地产管理、城市发展及当地社区创造价值，以及为何不同主体会选择参与其中。文章案例来自比利时、荷兰、葡萄牙、德国、意大利、库拉索岛和澳大利亚，归纳出四个相互关联的价值维度：空间激活、公共资源共享、社区关怀与空间转型。这些案例表明，临时社区所产生的影响会持续到临时使用期结束后，从而重塑人们对空间的认知和未来的发展方向。文章呼吁建立新的评估框架，以识别和支持这种复杂的价值。。

papers.title: Contemporaneous Transmission Networks and Systemic Risk in European Banking
papers.abstract: We study how contemporaneous equity-return transmission shapes systemic exposure among 51 listed European banks. Using a recursive non-Gaussian network model on volatility-standardized returns, we construct two market-capitalization-weighted measures based on direct and indirect transmission effects: the Systemic Impact Score (SIS), capturing a bank's potential influence on other institutions, and the Systemic Vulnerability Score (SVS), capturing its exposure to disturbances originating elsewhere. The fitted network reveals distinct transmitting and receiving roles, highlighting differences between institutions with substantial outward influence and those with high incoming sensitivity. Receiving roles are generally more reproducible than transmitting roles across repeated network discovery, and selected connections remain informative about lower-tail dependence in subsequent observations. Volatility standardization substantially reduces detected dependence among recovered shocks, although the full-sample model does not satisfy the designated criterion for supporting shock independence. Alternative recursive orderings also yield comparable directional tail asymmetries, limiting the extent to which these patterns validate a particular ordering. The results provide complementary measures of model-implied systemic transmission and vulnerability, with explicit attention to uncertainty and identification limits
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】我们研究了同期股票收益传导机制如何影响51家欧洲上市公司的系统性风险暴露。通过使用基于波动率标准化的收益的递归非高斯网络模型，我们构建了两个以市值为权重的指标，分别用于衡量直接和间接的传导效应：系统性影响得分（Systemic Impact Score, SIS），用于评估银行对其他机构的潜在影响；以及系统性脆弱性得分（Systemic Vulnerability Score, SVS），用于衡量银行对来自外部冲击的敏感度。拟合的网络模型揭示了不同机构在传导和接收冲击过程中的不同角色，突显了那些具有较强外部影响力机构与那些对外部冲击高度敏感的机构之间的差异。在多次网络重构过程中，接收冲击的机构角色通常比传导冲击的机构角色更具稳定性；某些关键连接在后续观测中仍能有效反映尾部依赖性特征。尽管波动率标准化处理显著降低了冲击之间的相关性，但整个样本模型的结果并未完全满足冲击独立性的判定标准。其他递归排序方法也得出了类似的方向性尾部不对称性，这表明这些模式并不能完全验证某种特定的排序方式。我们的研究为模型所揭示的系统性传导和脆弱性提供了互补的度量方法，并充分考虑了不确定性及模型识别的局限性。。

papers.title: Hosting is not capturing: an exposure-capability framework and Hungary's electric-vehicle battery bet
papers.abstract: How should a dependent economy respond when a polycrisis turns economic integration from a source of efficiency into a surface of vulnerability? This paper develops the exposure-capability framework, which maps a country's strategic options along two dimensions - the concentration of its external dependence and the depth of its productive capability - and yields four ideal strategies. It applies the framework to Hungary's large-scale bet on electric-vehicle battery manufacturing, asking what the concentrated exposure purchased: movement toward a higher position in the battery value chain, as a catch-up gamble, or the reproduction of the country's existing position under a new product, as dependent entrenchment. Using a firm-level panel of Hungary's largest companies for 2010-2024, it tests four hypotheses and examines the conditions attached to the support that financed the investments. The sector has expanded enormously, but its value capture neither rises beyond the recovery from construction losses nor shifts up the chain: production remains concentrated in the lowest-value stage, matures only to the level of comparably young foreign-owned firms, and does not cover its own costs. The support that financed it required investment volume, revenue and employment retention; capability-relevant criteria entered the decree as considerations rather than conditions, and a capability-contingent instrument within the same scheme went unused. On the evidence to 2024 the bet is a lateral substitution at constant quality, in which battery-cell fabrication replaces automotive assembly at the same dependent position. Hosting the green transition's supply chain, the case shows, is not the same as capturing its value.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】当多重危机使经济一体化从提高效率的途径转变为增加脆弱性的因素时，依赖型经济体应如何应对？本文提出了“暴露-能力框架”（Exposure-Capability Framework），该框架从两个维度——对外部依赖的集中程度以及生产能力的深度——来分析一个国家的战略选择，并据此提出了四种理想的战略方案。作者以匈牙利在电动汽车电池制造领域的大规模投资为例，探讨了这种集中性投资究竟带来了何种结果：是促使该国在电池产业链中向上攀升，实现追赶目标；还是使其在现有基础上通过新产品巩固自身依赖地位。研究使用了2010至2024年间匈牙利最大企业的微观数据，检验了四个相关假设，并分析了支持这些投资的政策条件。尽管该产业规模大幅扩张，但其价值创造能力并未显著提升——生产仍集中在产业链的低附加值环节，仅达到类似年轻外资企业的水平，且无法实现成本自给。为支持该产业所需的政策措施包括增加投资规模、保障收入和维持就业岗位；虽然政策文件中确实包含了与生产能力相关的考量因素，但这些因素并未被严格作为投资条件；同时，同一政策体系中原本设计的基于生产能力条件的激励机制也未能得到有效利用。根据截至2024年的数据，这...。

papers.title: The Effect of Investment Opportunity Set, Profitability, and Funding Decisions on Company Value in the Property and Real Estate Sector
papers.venue: Moneta : Journal of Economics and Finance
papers.abstract: This study aims to analyze the factors that cause company value to decline and fail to fully recover after the pandemic, as reflected in the average Tobin’s Q that remaining below one dring 2021 - 2024. This condition raises questions about the extent to which the Investment Opportunity Set (IOS), profitability, and funding decisions can explain variations in company value. The method used is a quantitative approach with panel data regression analysis. The sample consisted of 15 companies selected using purposive sampling based on data availability during the observation period. The results showed that IOS and funding decisions had a positive effect, whereas profitability did not. These findings suggest that the market responds more to growth prospects and funding structure than to profit performance when evaluating property and real estate companies during the post-pandemic period. Therefore, from a managerial perspective, optimizing investment opportunity set and appropriate funding decisions are key to increasing firm value. For investors, these findings indicate that growth prospects and funding structure should be a primary consideration in strategic decision-making.
papers.summary_zh: 【房地产金融】本研究旨在分析导致公司价值下降以及疫情过后未能完全恢复的因素，这一现象体现在2021年至2024年间公司的平均托宾Q值始终低于1。这一情况引发了关于投资机会集（Investment Opportunity Set, IOS）、盈利能力以及融资决策在多大程度上能够解释公司价值变化的问题。研究采用定量方法，通过面板数据回归分析来进行分析。样本选取了15家公司，这些公司是根据观察期间数据可获得性通过目的性抽样方法确定的。研究结果表明，投资机会集和融资决策对公司价值具有积极影响，而盈利能力则没有这种作用。这些发现表明，在评估疫情后的房地产公司时，市场更关注公司的增长前景和融资结构，而非其盈利表现。因此，从管理角度来看，优化投资机会集和做出适当的融资决策是提升公司价值的关键。对于投资者而言，这些发现意味着在战略决策过程中应将公司的增长前景和融资结构作为主要考虑因素。。研究方法：面板数据、回归分析。

papers.title: Financial trust and self-directed retirement investing in pension plans
papers.venue: Journal of Pension Economics and Finance
papers.abstract: Despite the increasing popularity of self-directed accounts within pension plans, little is known about what drives voluntary participation in such accounts. This paper examines how financial trust influences the usage of self-directed accounts in Singapore’s national pension scheme using data from the World Values Survey and instrumental variable methods. We find that financial trust drives self-investment of pension monies: A one-unit increase in trust increases the likelihood of participation by 45 percentage points, controlling for covariates. This finding remains robust when potential endogeneity and alternative empirical specifications are considered. Our findings highlight the critical role of trust in shaping retirement investment behavior and pension choices.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：金融信任如何影响新加坡国家养老金计划中自我导向账户的自愿参与？

🔬 研究方法：利用世界价值观调查数据，并采用工具变量方法来处理潜在的内生性问题。

📊 核心发现：研究发现金融信任显著驱动养老金投资，信任增加一个单位可使参与概率提高45个百分点，且该结论在控制协变量及考虑内生性后依然稳健。

💡 应用价值：该研究强调了信任在塑造退休投资行为和养老金选择中的关键作用。

papers.title: Economies of Collective Temporary Occupations in Brussels
papers.abstract: In European cities, strengthening local grassroots initiatives is trending. Citizen groups often find space only by temporarily occupying unused buildings, which, in turn, creates value through diverse activities and economies. While temporary uses are acknowledged for their capacity to generate social and cultural value, the diverse economies they activate remain undefined. This article investigates the economies generated by collective temporary occupations (CTOs) in the reuse of vacant real estate in the Brussels-Capital Region. Based on the hypothesis that CTOs contribute to post-growth urban development, this article explores economic activation, spatial characteristics, and temporal dimension in 10 cases. Results show that CTOs enhance place quality by combining artistic creation, sports facilities, circular production, welfare services, and sharing practices. From small neighbourhood infrastructure to large metropolitan hubs, temporality ranges from 1 to 10 years, with longer-lasting initiatives functioning as commons despite their temporary status. By recognising the diverse dimensions of value creation and the role of CTOs as generators of new economies, this research contributes to the study of temporary uses in post-growth urban planning.
papers.summary_zh: 【房地产金融】在欧洲城市中，加强地方基层倡议已成为一种趋势。市民团体通常通过暂时占用闲置建筑来获得活动空间，而这些空间通过各种多样的活动和经济活动创造了价值。尽管临时性使用方式因其能够产生社会和文化价值而受到认可，但其所激活的多元化经济形态尚未得到充分界定。本文研究了布鲁塞尔首都大区在重新利用闲置房地产过程中，通过集体临时占用（Collective Temporary Occupations, CTOs）所形成的经济效应。基于“CTOs有助于后增长时代城市发展”的假设，本文通过10个具体案例探讨了经济激活机制、空间特征及时间维度。研究结果表明，CTOs通过结合艺术创作、体育设施、循环生产、福利服务及共享模式等方式提升了场所品质。从小型社区基础设施到大型都市中心，这些临时性使用的持续时间从1年到10年不等；其中一些长期持续的倡议尽管具有临时性质，但仍发挥着公共空间的作用。通过认识到价值创造的多元维度以及CTOs作为新型经济形态创造者的角色，本研究为后增长时代城市规划中的临时性使用方式提供了有益的参考。。

papers.title: Optimal Order Placement under a State-Dependent Hawkes Process Limit Order Book model
papers.abstract: We study optimal quote placement for a market maker facing order flow modeled by a state-dependent Hawkes process. A block-based linear demand specification links market-order counts to execution volumes, providing the demand moments required by a continuous time discrete state dynamic programming formulation. Under a quadratic terminal inventory penalty, we characterize inventory-dependent quotes and derive backward recursions for the coefficients of a quadratic value function. Numerical experiments using LOBSTER data examine quote distributions, inventory exposure, and terminal wealth. The implemented strategy yields higher aggregate terminal wealth than fixed-spread benchmarks at one and three ticks, but lower wealth than the two-tick benchmark. These results illustrate the framework's numerical implementation and distinguish terminal-wealth comparisons from evaluation under the inventory-penalized objective.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了做市商在面对由状态依赖的Hawkes过程建模的订单流时的最优报价策略。基于块的线性需求模型将市场订单数量与执行量联系起来，为连续时间离散状态动态规划模型的构建提供了所需的需求数据。在考虑二次终端库存惩罚的情况下，我们分析了库存对报价的影响，并推导出了二次价值函数系数的递归计算方法。利用LOBSTER数据进行的数值实验考察了报价分布、库存风险以及最终财富水平。实践证明，该策略在单个和三个交易tick的情况下能够实现比固定利差策略更高的最终财富总额，但在两个交易tick的情况下财富水平低于后者。这些结果展示了该模型的数值实现方法，并明确了在考虑库存惩罚目标下的财富比较与常规评估方法之间的差异。。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: Climate change, sea level rise, and the agricultural revolution
papers.abstract: We test various hypotheses for the invention and spread of agriculture: higher temperatures, increased seasonality, carbon dioxide fertilization, sea level rise, and technological progress on the extensive margin. We successfully replicate Matranga (QJE 2024). His seasonality hypothesis survives alternative data, estimators, and competing hypotheses. Population density played a role in the invention of agriculture, while spatial diffusion was important for its spread. Sea level rise and climate change had a minor effect on the population density of the areas that first adopted agriculture. Extrapolating a logit model for the invention of agriculture, some now-submerged areas in the Persian Gulf, Mediterranean, and Yellow Sea were suitable for early agriculture. Over time, technological progress was the main factor in extending agriculture's extensive margin.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】我们检验了关于农业发明与传播的各种假说，包括温度升高、季节性增强、二氧化碳的肥料效应、海平面上升以及技术进步等因素对农业发展的影响。我们的研究结果成功复制了Matranga（QJE 2024）的研究结论。他的关于季节性变化的假说在面对不同的数据来源、估算方法以及其他竞争性假说时依然成立。人口密度在农业的发明过程中起到了重要作用，而空间扩散则对农业的传播具有关键意义。海平面上升和气候变化对最初采用农业的地区的人口密度影响较小。通过对农业发明过程的逻辑回归模型进行推断，我们发现波斯湾、地中海和黄海中一些如今已被淹没的区域在古代适宜发展农业。随着时间的推移，技术进步成为农业扩展的主要驱动力。。

papers.title: Personal preference or system role? Battery swapping among UK electric vehicle users
papers.abstract: Battery swapping replaces a depleted EV battery with a charged one, reducing waiting time and enabling off-peak charging. Evidence on acceptance, however, remains concentrated in Asian markets, and most studies examine individual adoption intentions. This study asks whether current UK EV users judge swapping differently as a purchase option and as a technology for the transport system. Using Behavioural Reasoning Theory, an integrated choice and latent variable model, and latent class analysis, we analyse perceived usefulness, energy-system concerns, practical barriers, and satisfaction with current charging. Usefulness and energy-system concerns relate more strongly to expectations about the system. Battery compatibility and station coverage relate more strongly to personal preference, while spare battery costs relate to expectations about network viability. User groups differ in how they balance benefits, barriers, and satisfaction with existing charging. Policy should address driver barriers and network viability as distinct but connected priorities.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：英国电动汽车用户是将电池交换视为个人购买选项，还是将其视为交通系统的技术？

🔬 研究方法：结合行为推理理论、集成选择和潜变量模型以及潜类分析。

📊 核心发现：研究发现有用性和能源系统担忧更关联系统期望，而电池兼容性和站点覆盖率更关联个人偏好；同时，不同用户群体在平衡利益、障碍和现有充电满意度方面存在差异。

💡 应用价值：政策制定者应将解决驾驶员障碍和网络可行性视为既独立又相互关联的优先事项。

papers.title: An Application of Geometric Riemannian Pricing Algorithm for Valuing Catastrophe Bonds in Incomplete Markets: Market-Consistent Financial Entropy and the Split of Frequency and Severity Risk Premia
papers.abstract: This paper presents a framework for pricing catastrophe (CAT) bonds in incomplete markets through Riemannian geometric optimization of financial entropy. We formulate pricing-measure selection as a maximum financial entropy problem on a finite-dimensional manifold of equivalent measures, parameterized by the non-hedgeable market prices of catastrophe frequency and severity risk, with discounting fixed by the default-free term structure. Since unconstrained entropy maximization recovers the physical measure, we incorporate observed secondary-market spreads, both pooled and date by date. For a compound Poisson-generalized Pareto loss model with Wang distortion, we derive closed-form expressions for financial entropy and the Riemannian metric. We show that CAT bond prices depend on frequency and severity premia primarily through the risk-neutral trigger intensity, making the two premia unidentifiable from market data alone; the entropy criterion resolves this ambiguity. Using a hypothetical earthquake CAT bond calibrated to quarterly spreads of Golden State Re II Ltd. (Series 2014-1), we obtain risk-neutral trigger intensities of 6.58 to 10.45 times the physical intensity (9.20 pooled and 18.26 at the end of 2015). The model-implied risk multiple aligns with the market spread-to-expected-loss ratio (8.87 versus 8.81 at issuance). The minimal-entropy measure attributes 53.5% to 63.7% of the log risk multiple to frequency risk, reflecting the selection principle rather than market identification. Finally, equating the coupon with the quoted spread understates the risk multiple by approximately half.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】本文提出了一种在非完全市场中对灾难（CAT）债券进行定价的框架，该方法基于金融熵的黎曼几何优化理论。我们将定价度量选择问题构建为一个在有限维流形上的最大金融熵问题，该流形由灾难发生频率和严重性风险的不可对冲市场价格参数化，折现率则由无违约的期限结构确定。由于无约束的熵最大化能够恢复物理度量，因此我们结合了观察到的二级市场利差数据（包括汇总数据及按日期划分的数据）。对于一个包含Wang畸变的复合泊松-广义帕累托损失模型，我们推导出了金融熵和黎曼度量的封闭形式表达式。研究表明，CAT债券的价格主要通过风险中性触发强度来反映频率和严重性风险，这使得这两种风险溢价无法仅通过市场数据单独识别；而熵准则能够消除这种不确定性。通过使用以Golden State Re II Ltd.（2014-1系列）季度利差为基准的假设地震CAT债券进行验证，我们得出的风险中性触发强度为物理强度的6.58至10.45倍（汇总数据为9.20倍，2015年底为18.26倍）。模型预测的风险倍数与市场利差与预期损失比率相符（分别为8.87倍和8.81倍）。最小熵度量将对数风险倍数的53.5%至63.7%归因于频率风...。研究方法：模型校准、优化方法。

papers.title: Identifying and disentangling direct and spillover effects using multiple pre-treatment periods
papers.abstract: Under interference, the treatment of some units affects the outcomes of others, so that the effect on a treated unit consists of a direct and a spillover component. A non-treated comparison group then generally identifies neither component, but the difference between the total effect on the treated and the spillover effect on the comparison units. We show that both components are identified separately when multiple pre-treatment periods are available, without an uncontaminated comparison group. Under no anticipation, pre-treatment outcomes are free of both components for every unit. Extrapolating the pre-treatment trend within a group, as in interrupted time series approaches, therefore identifies the counterfactual outcome in the absence of any treatment. Applied to the treated it gives the total effect on them, applied to the non-treated at a given level of exposure the spillover effect on them. Disentangling the two components in addition requires effect homogeneity across treated and non-treated units with the same exposure and covariates, as well as common support in exposure. We derive doubly robust and Neyman-orthogonal expressions for the effects of interest, which permits controlling for covariates by machine learning, and establish asymptotic normality. A simulation study confirms the root-$n$ behaviour of the estimators and the reliability of the standard errors. We apply the framework to the compulsory licensing of enemy-owned patents in the United States in 1919. Licensing raised patenting in the licensed subclasses and in technologically close ones alike, so that a comparison-group design understates the total effect.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在干扰因素的作用下，对某些单元的处理会影响到其他单元的结果，因此对受处理单元的影响包含直接效应和溢出效应两个部分。未经处理的对照组通常无法识别这两个效应，只能观察到受处理单元的总体效应与对照组受到的溢出效应之间的差异。我们证明了，在存在多个处理前时期且没有受污染的对照组的情况下，这两个效应是可以被分别识别的。在没有预期的情况下，每个单元的处理前结果都不包含这两个效应。通过类似中断时间序列方法的方式，对组内处理前趋势进行外推，可以得出在没有处理情况下的反事实结果：该方法对受处理单元而言能够得出其总体效应，对未受处理单元而言则能得出其在特定暴露水平下的溢出效应。要进一步区分这两个效应，还需要满足以下条件：受处理单元和未受处理单元在暴露程度和协变量方面具有同质性，并且在暴露水平上存在共同特征。我们推导出了双重稳健且符合Neyman正交性的效应表达式，这些表达式允许通过机器学习来控制协变量，并证明了效应的渐近正态性。模拟研究验证了估计量的根号n行为以及标准误差的可靠性。我们将这一框架应用于1919年美国对敌方拥有的专利实施强制许可的情况。该政策不仅提高了被许可专利子类别的专利申请数量，也...。研究方法：时间序列、数值模拟、机器学习。
